reason: brief P2j. hue and chroma of a custom illuminant are interface-only on desktop: _illum_xy_callback (src/iop/channelmixerrgb.c) turns them into the illuminant's x, y (dt_Lch_to_xyY at L 100 around D50) and its temperature (xy_to_CCT, below 3000 K CCT_reverse_lookup); gui_changed shows them back from x, y (dt_xyY_to_Lch; the hue only above chroma 0). app/schema Formulas.IlluminantHueChroma repeats both directions. The area mapping and colour checker controls wait for the colour picker and the chart tool. Brief P3c: the CAT tab's picker is desktop's _auto_set_illuminant (channelmixerrgb.c color_picker_apply): with a neutral target (lightness 50 %, chroma 0, desktop's area mapping off) module action illuminant_from_area, else spot with the area mapping's target; the area mode, "take channel mixing into account" and the target are interface-only on desktop (darkroom/modules/channelmixerrgb/*) and kept by the app as picker settings; a changed target in "correction" mode applies the armed picker again (_spot_settings_changed_callback). "measure" is not in the engine (engine-api.md 6.3) and stays greyed out.
